notes.title: Server Downtime for Update Notice
notes.content:
[p][b]Dear Gigaslave Players,[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Hello,[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]We will be performing a server maintenance update starting at 10:00 AM China Time on September 5th, which will last for 1 hour.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]For players in the Eastern Time Zone (USA), this will be at 9:00 PM on September 4th, with a duration of 1 hour.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]After the game update is complete, GMs will distribute compensation CDK codes online![/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]The update content is as follows:[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Box 1 has been updated with a new item: (Enhanced Ability Value Inheritance Item * 2 Usage Card). This item allows already enhanced weapons to inherit their ability values to any other weapon, including shields.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Box 1 now includes the new weapon HG2 (this weapon has the same performance as C18 but with increased ammunition capacity).[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Box 1 has added the new (Captain America Cosmetic Shield), which has the same performance as other shields in the game.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Box 2 now contains the Scar Starburst, a weapon that holds 5 more bullets than the regular Scar and features bullet explosion effects.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Box 2 has added the M200 Sniper Rifle, which has the same performance as the Barrett M95.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Box 3 now includes the new M40 Sniper Rifle, which has the same performance as the Barrett M95.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Box 3 has added an M4 Rifle, which has an extremely enhanced firing range compared to the original version.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Box 3 now contains a new costume: (Red Scarf Rebel) with the following ability values:[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]Attack Power increased by 5%[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bullet Speed increased by 5%[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Health increased by 7[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bullet Speed increased by 4%[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Movement Speed increased by 6%[/b][/p][/*][/olist][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Adjustments and Optimizations:[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]To reduce game crashes caused by memory overflow, we have reduced the maximum number of players to 10.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]To reduce tournament crashes, we have limited the maximum number of spectators to 10.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Increased tournament rewards.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]The following is the current top-up event:
::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]From after the game maintenance update until September 13th, players who accumulate top-up amounts of 500 gold will receive "Little Flying Dragon". It has the same performance as the Owl and can be carried as a follower in the game. Other players can press Control+K or Control+L to toggle its display on or off.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]From after the game maintenance update until September 13th, players who accumulate top-up amounts of 1000 gold will receive "AN94-GL". It has the same performance as the AN94 but with 5 additional bullets.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]From after the game maintenance update until September 13th, players who accumulate top-up amounts of 1500 gold will receive "L50 Interstellar Fantasy". It has the same performance as the original version but with 5 additional bullets and features bullet explosion effects.[/b][/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Regarding issues with in-game resolution and pet model size
notes.content: [p][b]Recently, some players have reported that the pet models in the game are too large. We would like to [/b][/p][p][b]respond to this issue as follows: When playing the game, if you use a resolution higher than 1024×768, [/b][/p][p][b]the pet models in this mode will be enlarged multiple times, which may affect the visual experience. It is [/b][/p][p][b]recommended to play the game in 1920×1080, 1600×900 (windowed or full-screen mode).[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596498/2e616d7955948ffe7f0950aa951f853a34db7bb4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596498/3b85df572d00815d2ac6ebe9d31df04cf8659f29.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The downtime update has been completed. Key points to note:
notes.content:
[p][b]The update has been completed, but some issues have not been resolved as originally planned. Please refer to the details below:[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Fixed the issue where the Death Mode did not increase authorized experience points. (Fixed)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed the inability to conduct CB matches. (Fixed)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed the issue where teammates could damage the box base in the map "Underground Factory". (Not directly fixed; instead, the difficulty of this map has been significantly reduced)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed the issue where the game would crash with a certain probability during enhancement. (Fixed)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed the issue where the loading time when joining the game was as long as 10-30 seconds. (Fixed)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed the issue where the game would crash with a certain probability when joining. (Fixed)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed the issue where multiple clicks to purchase in the in-game store would result in buying multiple items due to latency. (Fixed)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed the issues where weapons such as M202 and HK147 did not match the described performance and had incorrect time displays. (Fixed)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Modified and added daily mission rewards and completion conditions. (Completed)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added the in-game Honor Store system, with a large number of items available for players to redeem. Players can obtain balance to purchase rewards through in-game online time and the number of zombies killed. (Completed; items not yet added)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added room passwords for the cooperative mode, allowing access to the cooperative mode. (Uncompleted; passwords for the versus mode and cooperative mode have been canceled. notes.title: Announcement for "Nuclear Gold Storm" Rebirth Welfare Events
notes.content: [p][b]Dear Players,[/b][/p][p][b]To celebrate the brand-new rebirth of Gigaslave, the official team is launching a series of welfare activities to reciprocate the support and love of all players. The details of the activities are as follows:[/b][/p][p][b]Activity 1: Growth Assistance Program[/b][/p][p][b]To help all players quickly enhance their characters' combat power, the official team will launch a growth welfare distribution activity:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Activity Time (Eastern Time, USA): August 10th, 2000-2100[/b][/p][p][b]Activity Content: During the event, online GMs will log in to the game and conduct full-screen broadcasts for 1 hour. Meanwhile, the official website's CDK redemption system will be activated. Players can obtain the following rewards through redemption:[/b][/p][p][b]Type 1: Level 40 Gift Box ×40 (CDK)[/b][/p][p][b]Type 2: Hertz Gift Box ×60 (CDK)[/b][/p][p][b]Type 3: Zombie Set Box ×60 (CDK)[/b][/p][p][b]Type 4: Grade A Supply Crate ×50 (CDK)[/b][/p][p][b]Type 5: Game Currency Exchange Card (500,000) ×20 (CDK)[/b][/p][p][b]Notes: Each account can redeem each type of reward only once. Please do not attempt to redeem repeatedly.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Activity 2: Recharge to Win Exclusive Gifts[/b][/p][p][b]Activity Time (Eastern Time, USA): August 10th, 13:00 - August 17th, 13:00[/b][/p][p][b]Activity Description: Since the server opened on August 9th, all players who recharge through the in-game recharge channel and meet the following conditions will receive corresponding rewards (players who recharged and met the standards on August 9th will receive the rewards automatically):[/b][/p][p][b]Type 1: Recharge 500 points or more, and get the new cooperative mode enhanced pet "Mumu" (permanent) as an extra gift.[/b][/p][p][b]Type 2: Recharge 888 points or more, and get the new cooperative mode enhanced pet "Momo" (permanent) and the cute Egg Yolk Wings (permanent) as extra gifts.[/b][/p][p][b]Thank you all for your attention and support to Gigaslave. Wish you a pleasant gaming experience![/b][/p][p][b]Gigaslave Operation Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: The open non-deletion test is officially launched!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Dear Players of [i]Gigaslave[/i]:[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Greetings.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]First and foremost, we wish to extend our most sincere apologies to all players who have stood by us and waited patiently. During the first two tests, due to insufficient polishing of the version, we failed to deliver the gaming experience you anticipated, and this regret has lingered in our hearts. Over the past period, we have taken every piece of feedback as a driving force, and with reverence for the work and guilt towards players, we have repeatedly refined details and optimized the experience — now, we are finally able to respond to your expectations with a more mature stance.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]At this moment, filled with overwhelming excitement, we officially announce: the domestic server and Steam international server of [i]Gigaslave[/i] are about to launch simultaneously![/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]After days and nights of debugging, while retaining the core charm of the original Gigaslave engine, we have integrated a great deal of new content. From gameplay balance to visual performance, from operational smoothness to social experience, every modification embodies our pursuit of the "perfect version in players' hearts". For specific update details, you can check the official website ([/b][/p][p][b][url="https://www.aihjfb.cn"]www.aihjfb.cn[/url][/b][/p][p][b]). We believe this sincerity will make you feel our dedication.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]【Server Launch Information】[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]▶ Steam International Server
Launch Time: 18:00 on August 9, 2025 (U.S. Time) (Search for [i]Gigaslave[/i] to download)[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]In addition, the launch events for both servers have been launched simultaneously. You can log in to the official website to learn more details, and multiple benefits will boost your adventure.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]From the anxiety during the testing period to the certainty now, from the players' tolerance to our transformation, this journey has been extraordinarily meaningful because of your company. We are well aware that a launch is not an end, but a brand-new starting point — in the future, we will listen to feedback with a more open attitude, allowing [i]Nuclear Gold Storm[/i] to continue growing under your witness.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]We will be waiting for you in the game on August 9. May this time, we can embark on an adventure that lives up to expectations together.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]The [i]Nuclear Gold Storm[/i] Operation Team[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p]

notes.title: Open Letter from the Gigaslave Development Team to All Players
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596498/592fc597eb16146a4d342bb40a31280dd42a9c84.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Hello! First of all, we would like to express our most sincere apologies to all players who support and pay attention to "Nuclear Gold Storm". In the first two rounds of tests, due to our improper adjustment of the game rendering engine, many problems occurred in the game, and we failed to present you with the due gaming experience. This is our decision-making mistake - we should not have easily changed the "Nuclear Gold Storm" that players are familiar with, and we should not have let you pay the price of experience for our trial and error. On behalf of the development team, I would like to say sorry again to all the affected players.[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p][b]After in-depth reflection and full improvement, we have made clear the core direction: return to the original experience cherished by players, and steadily optimize on this basis. Now, the restoration and retention plan of game functions is announced as follows:[/b][/p][p]
[/p][olist][*][p]Restore the original DX rendering engine of "Nuclear Gold Storm" to ensure that the graphic performance returns to the classic texture.[/p][/*][*][p]Restore the original UI design of "Nuclear Gold Storm".[/p][/*][*][p]Restore the original shortcut button layout of "Nuclear Gold Storm".[/p][/*][*][p]Delete the attributes and values of all fashions, and only retain the set effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Restore the original skill configuration of "Nuclear Gold Storm" and restore the classic combat experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Based on the original zombie skeleton of the game, remake the new cooperative mode maps "Underground Processing Plant" and "Attacked Convoy" (see the attached pictures for details).[/p][/*][*][p]Retain the pool scene in the game's social area and continue the social space familiar to players.[/p][/*][*][p]Retain the weapon promotion system, authorization system and store weapon system in the game (see the attached pictures for details).[/p][/*][*][p]Add the content of "Death Warehouse · Comfort Version" (see the attached pictures for details).[/p][/*][*][p]Retain the Spine animation engine and weapon special effect system (see the attached pictures for details).[/p][/*][*][p]Retain the continuous fire weapon mechanism.[/p][/*][*][p]Retain all newly added equipment and fashions, taking into account freshness and collection value.[/p][/*][*][p]Add a pet system driven by the Spine animation engine to enrich the game companionship experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Retain the color word damage function, and support to obtain diversified hit font effects by carrying different font packages.[/p][/*][*][p]Add powerful purple-quality weapons, and more luxurious props will be dropped in the new cooperative maps (see the attached pictures for details of the illustrated handbook).[/p][/*][*][p]Greatly expand the daily tasks, activities, collection and sign-in systems in the game to enhance the long-term gaming fun.[/p][/*][*][p]Delete redundant existences, expand the commercial area and centralize all NPCs.[/p][/*][/olist][p]
[/p][p]Explanation on This Open Test[/p][p]
[/p][p]In order to ensure the quality of this test, we have completed comprehensive technical debugging and stress testing, and strive to present you with a stable and smooth gaming experience. The relevant arrangements for the test are as follows:[/p][p]
[/p][olist][*][p]Opening time of the open test: After the review by the Steam platform is passed (expected within 7 working days), we will notify the specific opening time through all official social groups.[/p][/*][*][p]Server configuration:[/p][list][*][p]Steam International Server: Supports Chinese and English, the server is located in Washington, requires logging in and recharging through a Steam account, and is open to overseas players.[/p][/*][*][p]Chuangyi Network Domestic Server: Supports Chinese and English, the server is located in Shenzhen, you need to register an account through the official website, log in and recharge, and it is open to domestic players.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Recharge refund plan:[/p][list][*][p]On the opening day of the server, a 70% refund of the order balance will be launched (for example, if you recharge an order of 1,000 yuan on Chuangyi Network, you can redeem 700 yuan to any account).[/p][/*][*][p]Players who participated in the recharge tests on July 5th and July 15th will receive an additional 20% refund based on the original refund ratio and return it to their original accounts.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist][p]
[/p][p][b]We know that trust requires long-term maintenance, and the only way to make up for our mistakes is to respond to everyone's expectations with a better gaming experience. During this test, we will listen to players' feedback throughout the process and continuously optimize the content, and will never live up to everyone's tolerance and waiting. Thank you for your perseverance and supervision. The growth of "Nuclear Gold Storm" is inseparable from your every attention. Looking forward to meeting you again in the game![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596498/b8f5a46bd4ec3213edd0456203ea8f6247d0b371.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596498/c8309c944584f90027047286bef49ae61e8fbef0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596498/09fdec4e7adbef9c0ac0e92ecf3c27fc6c51a9db.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596498/d155cd5f2b5814f284cfec65358ad39a20cc17fe.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596498/c690bacd1c176c9cf7f887732e09e3a7bdaed109.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596498/d954aa163f5fc39e5739c6633ab5848367016509.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596498/b7374e04849947217e4dc78abc5e472768902e87.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596498/a22de07c64bfe1a114d61ec45cf39e4b10ccbcd0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596498/61fe4f9cfd5518768aea9c9fcfc207c1b65fd133.png"][/img][/p]
